items.stem: Let p = log base 12 of 12 and q = log base 12 of 18. Which of the following expressions is equal to log base 12 of (8/27)?
items.explanation: Let u = log base 12 of 2 and v = log base 12 of 3. Then p = 2u + v and q = u + 2v, so p - q = u - v. Therefore, log base 12 of (8/27) = 3u - 3v = 3(p - q).

per_choice.correct: Let u = log base 12 of 2 and v = log base 12 of 3. Then p = 2u + v and q = u + 2v, so p - q = u - v. Therefore, log base 12 of (8/27) = 3u - 3v = 3(p - q).

items.stem: For x > 2, log base 2 of x + log base 2 of (x - 2) = 3. What is the value of x?
items.explanation: Using the product rule, log base 2 of [x(x - 2)] = 3, so x(x - 2) = 8. Solving x^2 - 2x - 8 = 0 gives x = 4 or x = -2; only x = 4 satisfies x > 2.

items.stem: Let a = log base 2 of m and b = log base 2 of n, where m and n are positive. Which of the following is equal to log base 8 of (m^2/sqrt(n))?
items.explanation: Using the power and quotient rules, log base 2 of (m^2/sqrt(n)) = 2a - b/2 = (4a - b)/2. Changing the base from 2 to 8 divides by log base 2 of 8 = 3, giving (4a - b)/6.
